description: Cykelpumpar is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Malmö stad. Publicly available bicycle pumps in the city of Malmö. Attribute id [pump identifier] typ [pump type] adress [street address] artal [year the pump was installed] geometry [pump position, type: Point, CRS: WGS84]. Coverage: Malmö stad. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle pumps" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Malmö stad. Its keywords include trafik, Malmö stad, gis, geodata, karta, map. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SQLITE3, CSV, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
